information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits a non-policy analysis that preserves provenance-linked supporting and opposing claims without exclusions or mandates. The final call consumes that analysis, directly receives every common input, may reinterpret or reject any transmitted claim, independently reconciles obligations and evidence, and emits one complete policy.

calls.objective: Map provenance-linked supporting and opposing claims, preserve unresolved conflicts, and expose obligation-relevant uncertainty without adjudicating commitments or constructing a policy.
